_comment: Release signing/verification policy (Task 31). Read by sign.ps1, verify-release.ps1 and release_verify.py. first_party / unsigned_by_design are matched case-insensitively against the FILE NAME; allowed_scripts against the path relative to the scanned folder, with forward slashes (fnmatch: * also matches /). sign_unsigned_bundled: also sign redistributed binaries that carry NO vendor signature (Smart App Control checks every DLL/.pyd that is loaded); vendor-signed files are never re-signed.

unsigned_by_design.adapter-setup-template.exe: The Manager appends each team's enrollment payload (TVLTCFG1) to a copy of this file; any Authenticode signature would be invalidated by the appended bytes. Team installers made from it are therefore always unsigned (use the no-exe portable package on Smart App Control machines).
